title: Matrix virial decomposition and a collision-free tensor stress test
exact_target: Find a conceptual proof of Saari’s conjecture and investigate the fixed-inertia-tensor analogue.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002543 (AIM-PHYSICS-0051). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 14.

status_qualification: The source has both a scalar conjecture and a proposed tensor variant. A tensor result is not a proof of the scalar conjecture, and dimensional/mass hypotheses must be stated for any claimed theorem. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
